title: Only 3 Interstellar Visitors—Each Faster Than Last
hook: The third interstellar visitor arrived at 246,000 kilometers an hour.
closing: Each visitor gives us a rare sample of another star system.
question: Will we ever catch one?

segments.say: Only 3 interstellar visitors have been confirmed, making every arrival a scientific windfall.
The newest reached 246,000 kilometers an hour, faster than either earlier visitor.
Its core is over 5 times wider than the previous record holder, offering more clues.
